definition.text: Judged of the Lord. (1.) A son of David by Abital (2 Sam. 3:4). (2.) A Benjamite who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:5). (3.) A Simeonite prince in David’s time (1 Chr. 27:16). (4.) One of Jehoshaphat’s sons (2 Chr. 21:2). (5.) Ezra 2:4. (6.) Ezra 2:57; Neh. 7:59. (7.) One of the princes who urged the putting of Jeremiah to death (Jer. 38:1-4).

lemmas.gloss: Shephatjah, the name of ten Israelites
Abital, a wife of King David
Pokereth-Tsebajim, one of the 'servants of Solomon'
Mikael, the name of an archangel and of nine Israelites
Zecarjah, the name of twenty-nine Israelites

chapters.title: How David Reigned Over One Tribe At Hebron While The Son Of Saul Reigned Over The Rest Of The Multitude; And How, In The Civil War Which Then Arose Asahel And Abner Were Slain.
